results.evidence: The diff adds conn.execute("BEGIN IMMEDIATE") before the first SELECT in log_event, log_correction and void_entry. tests/test_events_write_lock.py has three trace tests that check the BEGIN IMMEDIATE statement comes before the first SELECT, one per function. It also has a two-connection test: while the first void holds the lock, a second void_entry on the same entry raises OperationalError 'database is locked'. After the first commits, the second is refused with 'already void', and exactly one void row exists. All 4 tests pass.
